title: eriochasma tomentosa
intro: Eriochasma tomentosa, commonly known as the "tomentose leafy Eriochasma", is a plant species in the family Loganiaceae. It is an herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Philippines, where it is valued for its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to lower fever, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. Bioactive constituents of Eriochasma tomentosa include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
